title: EE60054: Discrete-Event Systems
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

State Transition Systems: Finite state machines (FSM) and its variants,
Modelling practical systems as FSMS, Properties of FSM and analysis methods.
Infinite state machines, Higher level descriptions of state transition
systems e.g. Petri Nets, State charts etc.
Control in Finite State Machines: Language control and state control problems.
Algorithms for supervisory control. The observation problem. Control with
partial observation.
Performance Modelling and Analysis of Discrete Event Systems (DES).
Fundamentals of Queueing Theory. Queueing models for DES, Stochastic
Petrinets. Performance Analysis methods. Application Examples for
Manufacturing Process Scheduling, Computer Networks etc.
